resources.string: Translate Discord messages and switch between original and translated text.
Settings save on this device and sync when LSPosed is available.
Saved on this device. Sync will retry when LSPosed reconnects.
Saved locally, but could not sync with LSPosed.
Invalid settings. Review the values and try again.
Saved settings are invalid. They have not been loaded or changed. Editing, saving, checks, requests, and sync are blocked. Reset saved settings explicitly to configure again.

This permanently deletes ALL stored configuration: API URL, API key, model, target language, headers, system prompt, provider protocol, streaming, timeout, concurrency, and the auto-translation switch. Deletions sync to LSPosed when available. Defaults become active after reset; nothing is deleted unless you confirm. Continue?
Reset could not be persisted. Configuration remains locked. %1$s
All stored settings were reset and synced to LSPosed. Defaults are now active. Restart Discord to apply.
All stored settings were reset on this device. Defaults are now active locally. LSPosed was unavailable; remote deletion will retry when it reconnects.
All stored settings were reset on this device, but deletion could not sync to LSPosed. Remote settings may still be active. Sync will retry when LSPosed reconnects.
Saved. Restart Discord to apply the changes.

Off by default. Save to enable settings-page diagnostics in logcat; draft changes do not enable logs. Discord project logs use logcat and LSPosed after sync and restart. No message text, credentials, or raw responses are logged.
Enter the API base URL ending in /v1. The protocol endpoint is added automatically.
Extra headers (one Name: Value per line)
Translate only. Do not answer or add text.
Message text is sent to your configured translation service. API keys stay on this device.
Test failed. See the result below.
Settings check passed (%1$d ms). No network request was sent; connectivity and translation were not tested.
Connection test passed (%1$d ms). The request and complete protocol response were verified; translation preservation was not tested.

Translation test passed (%1$d ms). The complete response passed text checks for empty output, wrapper/old segment markers, retained-node markers, template placeholders, and length ratio. Discord node reconstruction is not tested here.

Invalid configuration. Use an http:// or https:// base URL, for example https://api.openai.com/v1, without /chat/completions, /responses, or /messages. Check the protocol, model, positive timeout/concurrency, and headers in Name: Value format.
The network connection failed. Check internet access, DNS, TLS certificates, and any VPN or proxy; then retry manually.
The request timed out while connecting or waiting for data. Check service availability and increase Timeout (ms), then retry. This is not a model stop or a translation validation failure.
The service rejected the request parameters (400). Check the model, provider protocol, and streaming support; use a base URL such as /v1 without the protocol endpoint.
Authentication failed (401). Check the API key and authentication headers for the selected service.
Access was denied (403). Check API key permissions and whether your account can access the selected model and service.
The endpoint or model was not found (404). Check the model and protocol. Enter only the API base URL, such as https://api.openai.com/v1; do not include /chat/completions, /responses, or /messages.
The service returned a server error. Check provider status and retry manually later; changing translation validation will not fix a service failure.
The service returned an unsuccessful HTTP status. Check the base URL, protocol, model, key permissions, and provider documentation; no response body is displayed.
The service rate limit was reached. Wait before retrying, reduce Maximum concurrent requests, and check account quota.

The response did not match the selected protocol or was invalid. Select the correct provider protocol and response mode: streaming requires SSE, and non-streaming requires JSON. Check that the base URL, such as /v1, does not already contain the endpoint; HTTP 200 alone is not enough.

The response ended before protocol completion. Check the service or proxy for truncated JSON or missing SSE completion events, and ensure the streaming switch matches SSE/JSON support. No partial output is accepted.

The model returned a non-normal completion reason, for example an output limit. Check model limits and use a translation-only prompt with a shorter input. This is not a network timeout; increasing Timeout (ms) does not fix a model stop. Refusals or unsupported tool responses are generally invalid responses instead.

The complete response failed text preservation checks, such as wrapper pollution, old segment or retained-node markers, template placeholders, or abnormal length ratio. Use a translation-only prompt and a suitable model. Increasing Timeout (ms) does not fix changed content; no damaged translation is displayed. Discord node reconstruction is checked separately.
The input or extracted text was empty. Enter nonblank test text; if input is present, check the model, prompt, and selected provider protocol.
The test was cancelled. Keep the settings page open and start a new test when ready.
An unexpected failure occurred. Check the exception type below and enable project logs by saving the switch before retrying manually. Logs do not include exception messages or raw responses.
